summary: Frontend-only test at 390x844 (web preview) of the MASS purchase + property unlock flows. PASS: 5 MASS bundle cards (bundle-starter/explorer/hunter/investor/professional) with exact naira ₦500/₦1,000/₦2,500/₦5,000/₦10,000; Explorer selection -> buy-total ₦1,000, buy-total-tokens '10 MASS · Paystack'; confirm-purchase-btn -> POST /api/payments/initialize 200 with https public checkout_url, popup opened and self-closed, status poll -> purchase-success '10 MASS credited · ₦1,000 paid · Receipt AMS-20261024-B6D46A'; balance 13,650 -> 13,660 (credited exactly once); purchase-success-continue -> /wallet. buy-open-checkout link visible while processing. Wallet receipt row + receipt-sheet show AMS receipt no., wallet hero shows '1 MASS = ₦100', Reference ellipsized with no overflow. Property unlock (detail page): dialog shows '60 MASS = ₦6,000', '₦100 = 1 MASS · Zone B · Sale', Cancel -> only POST /unlocks/cancel, balance unchanged; Confirm -> balance 13,660 -> 13,600 (exactly 60), receipt AMS-20261024-3F8C3C in ledger. Home map pin -> preview-primary 'Unlock · 120 MASS' -> UnlockDialog (Zone A · Sale) -> Cancel, nothing charged. Insufficient balance (fixa tester temporarily set to 50 MASS): 'Short by 70 MASS = ₦7,000 · nothing charged', Cancel + Get MASS (no confirm button); Get MASS -> /buy-tokens?currency=MASS&returnTo=/property/<id>&unlock=1; purchase -> success sheet 'Continue' -> back to property with dialog re-opened (now 60 MASS, short by 60), no POST /unlocks issued, property still locked. /buy-fix renders 4 fix-bundle-* cards and confirm-fix-purchase. FAIL: Starter Pack (₦500, MASS) and FIX Starter (₦500) are shown and selectable but POST /api/payments/initialize returns 422 'Minimum top-up is ₦1,000'.

minor.issue: Returns 422 'Minimum top-up is ₦1,000' for bundle_id=starter (MASS ₦500) and fix_starter (FIX ₦500). The bundle catalog advertises these bundles but the server's topup_min_ngn default (1000) rejects them. Reference: /app/backend/payments.py:285-288

ui_bugs.issue: bundle-starter (₦500) and fix-bundle-fix_starter (₦500) can be selected and paid for, but every attempt ends in a 'Purchase failed · Minimum top-up is ₦1,000' toast. Either take bundles below topup_min_ngn out of the catalog (or disable them in the UI with a 'min ₦1,000' note), or lower the minimum to ₦500.
The heading is all lowercase: 'unlock this home' / 'unlock this provider'. It should probably read 'Unlock this home'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui/UnlockDialog.tsx:153

integration_issues.issue: finish() calls router.replace(returnTo), but the original property screen is still in the stack under /buy-tokens. After Continue you end up with two property/[id] screens, and the page has 2 unlock-cta-btn elements. Pressing Back shows the same property again. Use router.back() (or dismissTo) when returnTo matches the previous route. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TokenPurchaseScreen.tsx:160-167

issues: The body text is joined with ' · ', so the second line starts with a stray dot: '... (and your email). · Your wallet is topped up and ready to use.' / '· Let's finish what you started.' Use a line break or a full stop instead.

While processing, the CTA shrinks to a ~72px spinner circle to make room for 'Checkout didn't open? Tap here'. It works, but the CTA width jumps; consider keeping the full width and putting the link underneath.
The web fallback map background is a generic Europe map tile ('Satellite imagery renders on mobile') behind Lagos pins. This is web-only and expected, noted for awareness.

action_items: HIGH: Make the bundle catalog match the top-up minimum. MASS 'starter' (₦500) and FIX 'fix_starter' (₦500) are listed but /api/payments/initialize rejects them with 422 because topup_min_ngn defaults to 1000 (payments.py:286). Either drop or disable bundles below the minimum in GET bundles, or set the minimum to 500.
LOW: Capitalise the UnlockDialog heading ('Unlock this home') at UnlockDialog.tsx:153.
LOW: When the purchase came from an unlock flow (returnTo), return with router.back()/dismissTo instead of router.replace so the property screen isn't duplicated in the stack.
LOW: Fix the stray ' · ' separator in the purchase-success sheet body copy.
critical_code_review_comments: TokenPurchaseScreen.tsx:120: on web, openAuthSessionAsync is fire-and-forget and the 40x1.5s poll is the source of truth. That is correct, and the pending/failed states are handled.
wallet.tsx:507: react-native-web does not support ellipsizeMode='middle' and falls back to tail ellipsis. The Reference doesn't overflow, but the end of the reference is hidden. Acceptable.

AnimatedNumber (buy-balance) counts up from an intermediate value on mount, so a read right after load shows e.g. 10,810 before it settles at 13,650. It's cosmetic only; tests should read balances from the API or wait about 1.5s.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all 6 requested flows pass; the ₦500 Starter bundles fail at initialize)

seed_data_creation: Admin adjustments on fixa.tester+15339 (id f26f8364-...): -230 MASS ('TEST iter75 insufficient-balance setup') and then +220 MASS ('TEST iter75 restore'). context_for_next_testing_agent: Login returns access_token (not token). Bundle testIDs: bundle-<id> for MASS, fix-bundle-<id> for FIX, confirm: confirm-purchase-btn / confirm-fix-purchase. Unlock: unlock-cta-btn on property/[id] (dialog may auto-open ~600ms after load), unlock-dialog/unlock-fee/unlock-cancel/unlock-confirm/unlock-fund. Map: pin-<id> -> preview-primary-<id>. Locked property for fixa tester: 7d769d80 (Zone A sale 120 MASS) and f2342766 (Zone A sale 120). Use POST /api/admin/wallet/{user_id}/adjust (demo admin) to set up the insufficient-balance case, because fixa tester has 280 MASS > max fee 120.
rca_of_issue: Starter purchase 422: payments.initialize reads monetization.topup_min_ngn (default 1000) and rejects amount_ngn < min, while the MASS/FIX bundle catalogs still include ₦500 starter bundles. Repro: /buy-tokens -> bundle-starter -> confirm-purchase-btn -> toast 'Purchase failed · Minimum top-up is ₦1,000'.
